title: Multigroup Sculping: Engulfing + Linear Grid
entry_long: EMA3>EMA200, EMA3>EMA8, bullish engulfing (body ID1>ID2), RSI<30 (optional)
entry_short: mirror: EMA3<EMA200, EMA3<EMA8, bearish engulfing, RSI>70 (optional)
exit: Profit close at 5 USD, no SL, trailing stop 500/step100
buildon_idea: capped at 5 lots; linear add only on 5-lot increments; test with flat lot first; adjust grid spacing (100pip default)
novelty_note: EMA alignment + body-size engulfing filter + linear escalation grid without martingale

title: Multigroup Scouting: Step-based Escalation with Sculping Filter
entry_long: bullish divergent EMA + 70% body filter on engulfing (ID1 body > 70% ID2 body), RSI oversold optional
entry_short: bearish divergent EMA + 70% body filter, RSI overbought optional
exit: 5 USD target, adaptive close based on open orders (5+orders*5)
buildon_idea: step-based escalation (every 5 trades); 70% body size filter reduces false signals; dual-mode PH_Train/Reverse_Train; test rebalance thresholds
novelty_note: 70% body-size filter for engulfing + state-machine dual-mode entry (follow vs reverse trend)

title: Go Robot: WPR Oversold + Doji Pattern
entry_long: WPR<-80 (oversold) + doji bullish (lower wick>upper wick, small body)
entry_short: WPR>-20 (overbought) + doji bearish (upper wick>lower wick, small body)
escalation_cap: 50 lots max in reverse mode, no cap in follow mode
buildon_idea: doji pattern confirmation reduces WPR false-signal noise; capped reverse-mode at 50 lots; add position cap in follow-trend mode; test on H4/higher TF first
novelty_note: WPR oversold/overbought with doji confirmation (small-body pattern); wig-based doji definition

title: Go Robot V2: WPR + Doji + Time Filter
entry_long: WPR<-80 + doji (lower wig > upper wig) + EMA8>EMA200
entry_short: WPR>-20 + doji (upper wig > lower wig) + EMA8<EMA200
exit: 100 pips close money, trailing stop dynamic (TS+ATR×2)
buildon_idea: ATR-adjusted trailing stop makes grid robust to volatility; time filter mode (14:00-20:00 UTC) cuts drawdown from 8 to 4 cut-loss events in 2-year test; test both modes
novelty_note: ATR-scaled trailing stop + optional time-window filter + rebalance close formula (5+orders/5×5)

title: Go Robot Engulfing: Doji + Bullish/Bearish Engulfing
entry_long: Doji bearish (ID2: open>close) + bullish engulfing (ID1 open<close, ID1 body>ID2 body) + price>EMA200
entry_short: Doji bullish (ID2: open<close) + bearish engulfing (ID1 open>close, ID1 body>ID2 body) + price<EMA200
exit: 100 pips profit, no SL, no TP
buildon_idea: doji+engulfing combo reduces early entries; cap at 50 orders; test body-size thresholds (min 1.5× or 2× difference); spread-stress test under high volatility
novelty_note: Doji precedes engulfing (setup+confirmation); body-ratio gating on engulfing pattern

title: Multi-Group Rebalance: Pin Bar + Engulfing + Profit%
escalation_cap: 50 orders per group, Max DD tracked
buildon_idea: profit%-based close (1% vs 0.1%) adapts to account size; dual-group allows asymmetric risk (buy heavy vs sell heavy); track max DD for risk management; test balance-scaling on small accounts
novelty_note: Percentage-of-balance exit (dynamic per account) vs fixed pips; separate max DD tracking per group

title: Multigroup Sculping: MACD Divergent + Engulfing
entry_long: MACD bullish divergent + bullish engulfing (ID1 body>ID2 body) + EMA8>EMA200
entry_short: MACD bearish divergent + bearish engulfing (ID1 body>ID2 body) + EMA8<EMA200
exit: 5 USD close, step-based escalation every 5 trades
buildon_idea: MACD divergent (price/MACD divergence) + engulfing confirmation; cut-loss at 15 orders or 30% balance DD; ATR-dynamic trailing stop; step-escalation prevents lot explosion
novelty_note: MACD divergent (uses FXDMA divergent block) + body-size engulfing filter; divergent precedes reversal better than oversold indicators

title: Multigroup Sculping: MACD Divergent Simplified

entry_short: MACD bearish divergent + bearish engulfing + price<EMA200
exit: 5 USD fixed, adaptive based on order count
